theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals is the highest-ranked eligible theme not flagged as crowded, and the absolute-trend gate (the one validated risk-control leg) keeps downside risk contained. While momentum rank alone has no alpha, the gate’s drawdown avoidance justifies a modest overweight on a risk-control basis.
evidence: rank 3 in relative momentum (attention lens only)
theses.dissent: durability is weak (0.47) and breadth is thin (0.111), so the trend could fail quickly; materials face headwinds from trade disputes and geopolitics-driven demand uncertainty.

falsifier.text: Base Metals loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate turns false) or durability drops below 0.3.
